artifacts.summary: Confirms Defect A's content-exists/reach-gap split mechanically (index-entries.json + planner-agent.md), rejects the naive index-entries fix via context-discovery.md's OR-semantics hazard, derives and verifies Defect B's correct longFile linter acceptance window against Mathlib master source and both citations, and resolves the dispatch's prior-record/dependency disposition questions.

memory_candidates.content: context-discovery.md's 'Adaptive Context Loading' query ORs the agents[]/task_types[]/commands[] load_when dimensions independently. A domain-specific index-entries.json entry must never add a cross-domain SHARED agent (planner-agent, general-implementation-agent, general-research-agent) to agents[] to make it reach that agent for one task_type -- the OR semantics make it match that agent on every task_type, leaking domain content everywhere. The safe reach mechanism for a shared agent is a task_type-gated conditional pointer written inside that shared agent's own file, not an index-entries.json change.

Mathlib's linter.style.longFile acceptance rule (verified against master source and two independent citations): candidate = max(defValue=1500, floor(lines/100)*100 + 200); a declared set_option linter.style.longFile N is accepted without warning only when N == candidate or N == candidate - 100. A baseline bumped to its eventual final value ahead of the file's current line count will warn, because candidate is computed from CURRENT lines, not a target -- each phase that grows the file past a 100-line boundary must re-tighten N itself.

derived_artifact_probes (declared under .claude-extensions.json, schema: component/check_command/derived_output_dirs, read by scripts/lib/derived-artifact-probe-lib.sh) is the existing repo-declared, fail-open-on-absence precedent for a 'coupling list' advisory check, but it is wired only into implement-postflight staleness checking and has no field for the SOURCE pattern that triggers a coupling -- a plan-time declaration-completeness check needs a differently-shaped sibling declaration (e.g. coupled_generated_surfaces: [{trigger_glob, generated_paths}]), not a reuse of this schema.
